opportunities.title: Bulbula Integrated Agro-Industrial Park (IAIP)
opportunities.location: Bulbula (near Batu/Ziway), East Shewa / West Arsi Corridor
opportunities.summary: Flagship integrated agro-processing park equipped with cold chain logistics, processing sheds, and direct expressway connectivity.
opportunities.description: Bulbula Integrated Agro-Industrial Park (IAIP) is a major government-developed industrial zone along the Modjo-Hawassa corridor. It features pre-serviced plots, centralized effluent treatment plants, cold storage, quality laboratories, and dedicated utility access.
incentives: 100% exemption from customs duties on capital goods
Up to 6 years income tax holiday
Subsidized lease rates in designated agro-industrial cluster
Streamlined customs clearance via Mojo Dry Port corridor

opportunities.title: Dukem Eco-Industrial Garment & Technical Textile Park
opportunities.summary: Export-oriented garment and spinning plant utilizing regional cotton production, with zero-liquid discharge water treatment.
opportunities.description: Situated in the industrial heartland of Dukem, minutes away from the Addis Ababa-Djibouti railway depot. The project is pre-cleared with electrical substation connectivity and industrial waste treatment infrastructure.
incentives: Duty-free import of specialized textile machinery
Access to preferential export tariffs under regional trade agreements
Dedicated one-stop licensing and work permit assistance

opportunities.title: Jimma Specialty Coffee Value-Addition & Roasting Cluster
opportunities.landAvailable: 20 Hectares with water and power connections
opportunities.summary: Modern wet-processing, grading, roasting, and eco-packaging cluster directly sourcing from heirloom Arabica coffee cooperatives.
opportunities.description: Jimma is globally acclaimed as the birthplace of Arabica coffee. This opportunity provides land and cooperative linkages for private roasters and extract processors aiming at high-margin direct specialty exports to EU, North America, and Middle East markets.
incentives: Guaranteed raw bean supply contracts through regional cooperative unions
Full duty-free capital equipment import
Foreign exchange retention incentive account for coffee exporters
opportunities.contactPerson: Oromia Coffee & Spices Export Desk, Phone: +251 11 553 7788

opportunities.title: Adama Solar Power Component Manufacturing & Assembly
opportunities.landAvailable: 15 Hectares within Adama Special Economic Zone
opportunities.summary: Photovoltaic panel assembly, inverter manufacturing, and rural off-grid solar equipment plant serving East Africa.
opportunities.description: With Oromia's rapid electrification push and huge solar irradiance, this manufacturing plant will produce solar home systems, commercial solar modules, and smart agricultural pumps.
incentives: Tax holiday for tech manufacturing up to 7 years
Strategic national priority supplier status
Free Trade Zone tax perks on exported components

opportunities.title: Borena Modern Livestock Abattoir & Meat Processing Facility
opportunities.summary: Halal-certified meat processing, cold chain, and byproduct extraction plant for high-volume exports to the Gulf states.
opportunities.description: Borena holds one of Africa's largest and most organic pastoral cattle and goat populations. The project connects directly with the newly completed Hawassa-Moyale international highway.
incentives: Customs fast-track for refrigerated transport fleets
Exclusive quarantine station partnership
Zero export tax

opportunities.title: Bale Mountain Organic Honey & Forest Beeswax Processing Cluster
opportunities.landAvailable: 18 Hectares with pristine mountain spring water
opportunities.summary: Organic processing, honey refining, pharmaceutical-grade beeswax extraction, and export packaging cluster sourcing from Bale forest beekeepers.
opportunities.description: The Bale eco-region produces world-famous white and amber forest honey. This project establishes state-of-the-art filtration, centrifugal extraction, and direct certified organic export packaging for the European and Middle Eastern markets.
incentives: Certified organic eco-tax exemption for 5 years
Preferential mountain forestry land concession
Direct linkage with 45 primary beekeeping cooperatives
opportunities.contactPerson: Oromia Honey & Agro-Forestry Promotion Desk, Phone: +251 11 551 2233

opportunities.title: Arsi Highland Malting Barley & Industrial Grain Milling Complex
opportunities.landAvailable: 35 Hectares connected to national highway grid
opportunities.summary: High-capacity commercial malt production and durum wheat milling plant supplying domestic beverage brewers and regional bakeries.
opportunities.description: Arsi is the undisputed grain basket of Ethiopia. This facility bridges the national malt import deficit by contracting over 12,000 smallholder barley farmers and deploying modern European malting drum technology.
incentives: Full duty-free capital equipment import
Priority grain silo storage land allocation
7-year regional industrial income tax waiver

tradeProducts.name: Oromia Specialty Single-Origin Arabica Coffee
tradeProducts.originZones: Jimma, Guji, Limmu, Yirgacheffe border, West Hararghe
tradeProducts.exportSpecs: Grade 1 & Grade 2 Washed/Natural, Specialty Cup Score 86-90+, 60kg GrainPro lined jute bags.
tradeProducts.description: Oromia accounts for over 65% of Ethiopia's total coffee production. Renowned globally for complex flavor profiles ranging from floral jasmine and peach notes (Guji/Limmu) to bold chocolate spice tones (Harar).
tradeProducts.seasonality: Harvest: October - January | Peak Shipping: February - August

tradeProducts.name: Wollega & Harar Premium White Sesame Seeds
tradeProducts.originZones: East Wollega, West Wollega, Qellam Wollega, Hararghe
tradeProducts.exportSpecs: Purity 99.5% min, Admixture 0.5% max, Moisture 5.5% max, Oil content 52% min.
tradeProducts.description: High oil content and sweet nutty aroma make Oromia sesame seeds the world benchmark for gourmet tahini, halva, and cold-pressed export oil in Asian and Middle Eastern markets.
tradeProducts.seasonality: Harvest: November - January | Peak Shipping: Year-round

tradeProducts.name: Bale Cloud-Forest Organic White & Amber Honey
tradeProducts.originZones: Bale, Guji, Ilu Aba Bor highlands
tradeProducts.exportSpecs: 100% Pure Raw Organic, Moisture < 18%, HMF < 15 mg/kg, Residue-free, 25kg stainless drums.
tradeProducts.description: Harvested from wild multi-floral forest canopies in the Bale Mountains National Park buffer zone. Acclaimed internationally for creamy white crystallization and smooth medicinal notes.
tradeProducts.seasonality: Peak Harvest: May - June & November - December

tradeProducts.name: Ziway & Bishoftu Export Highland Cut Flowers
tradeProducts.exportSpecs: Stem length 50cm-90cm, bud size 5-7cm, temperature-controlled cold chain to Bole Cargo.
tradeProducts.description: Oromia's volcanic highland soils and abundant freshwater lakes provide the premier microclimate for long-stem T-hybrid roses, hypericum, and gypsophila shipped daily to European flower auctions.

tradeProducts.name: Borana Organic Pastoral Chilled Beef & Mutton
tradeProducts.originZones: Borana, Guji, Bale lowlands, East Hararghe
tradeProducts.exportSpecs: Halal certified, ISO 22000 abattoir chilled carcasses (10-16kg shoat, 180-240kg beef), zero antibiotic residue.
tradeProducts.description: Free-range, acacia savannah-grazed organic Boran cattle and Blackhead Somali sheep processed in export abattoirs with direct 4-hour air freight to Dubai, Riyadh, and Kuwait.
tradeProducts.seasonality: Continuous year-round supply with peak seasonal Eid volumes

tradeProducts.name: Rift Valley Organic Chickpeas & Red Speckled Beans
tradeProducts.exportSpecs: Machine cleaned & polished, Size 8mm-10mm (Chickpeas), Moisture 11% max, 50kg PP bags.
tradeProducts.description: Naturally grown in mineral-rich volcanic ash plains of the Central Rift Valley. High protein legumes exported in bulk to Middle Eastern, Indian, and Mediterranean food canners.

tradeProducts.name: Oromia Strategic Minerals: Cut Granite, Marble & Tantalite
tradeProducts.exportSpecs: Polished dimension stone slabs (2cm/3cm), Tantalite concentrate (Ta2O5 min 45%).
tradeProducts.description: High-grade industrial stones and tantalite concentrates sourced from registered regional concessions, pre-cleared for export to global aerospace, tech, and architectural markets.
tradeProducts.seasonality: Year-round scheduled quarry and processing dispatch

services.title: New Investment Permit Issuance
services.description: Full registration and permit issuance for domestic, joint venture, and foreign commercial investors.
services.eligibility: Any domestic entrepreneur or foreign enterprise with verified minimum capital threshold.
services.requirements: Valid passport/ID, draft business plan, notarized articles of association, tax identification number (TIN).
services.procedure: 1. Submit online inquiry/application -> 2. Document verification by Investment Desk -> 3. Permit approval within 48 hours.

services.title: Industrial & Agricultural Land Allocation Facilitation
services.description: Identification and facilitation of state-backed leased land for manufacturing, agriculture, and tourism.
services.eligibility: Approved investment permit holders with submitted feasible project proposal.
services.requirements: Approved Investment Permit, Detailed Environmental & Feasibility Study, Land Bank requisition form.
services.procedure: 1. Joint site inspection with Bureau engineers -> 2. Land Bank committee evaluation -> 3. Lease agreement signing.
services.fees: Regulated regional lease rates based on tier

services.title: Duty-Free Capital Goods Exemption Endorsement
services.description: Endorsement letters issued to the Ethiopian Customs Commission for 100% duty-free machinery and capital goods import.
services.eligibility: Investors in manufacturing, agriculture, mining, or priority commercial services.
services.requirements: Bill of Lading, Proforma invoices of machinery, valid investment license, approved capital asset schedule.
services.procedure: 1. Upload machinery invoices -> 2. Technical inspection -> 3. Electronic endorsement dispatched to Customs.

services.title: Export Trade Business License & Renewal
services.description: Commercial registration, export license issuance, and annual renewal for trading businesses operating in Oromia.
services.eligibility: Registered sole proprietors, PLC companies, and agricultural cooperative unions.
services.requirements: Renewed commercial registration, warehouse inspection certificate, tax clearance from Oromia Revenue Authority.
services.procedure: 1. Apply via Business Portal -> 2. Verification of tax clearance -> 3. Digital license issuance.

services.title: Buyer-Seller Market Linkage & B2B Facilitation
services.description: Direct matchmaking between regional producers (coffee, grain, livestock) and international buyers/importers.
services.eligibility: Certified regional producers and accredited international procurement representatives.
services.requirements: Product specification sheet, volume capacity certification, trade credentials.
services.procedure: 1. Register interest at Trade Desk -> 2. Matchmaking session arranged -> 3. Sample dispatch facilitation.

news.title: Oromia Trade and Investment Bureau Formally Established Following Strategic Restructuring
news.summary: The newly consolidated Bureau combines trade and investment mandates to accelerate industrialization, export diversification, and one-stop business facilitation across Oromia.
news.content: Under the regional government's institutional modernization agenda, the former Oromia Investment and Industry Bureau and the Oromia Trade Bureau have merged into a unified powerhouse. The new Bureau provides investors and traders with single-window service delivery, eliminating red tape and ensuring rapid project execution.

news.title: Bureau Signs 8.2 Billion ETB Investment Agreements for Modern Agro-Processing Clusters
news.summary: New private-public partnerships signed for modern dairy, avocado oil extraction, and honey processing facilities in Arsi and Jimma zones.
news.content: During the quarterly regional economic forum held in Finfine, Bureau leadership signed agreements with five prominent international and domestic consortiums. The projects will create over 4,200 direct employment opportunities and anchor regional smallholder contract farming.

news.title: Record Coffee Export Volumes Reported for First Quarter of 2026/27 Fiscal Year
news.summary: Oromia specialty coffee shipments reached historic highs, with European and Asian specialty roasters acquiring over 48,000 metric tons of Arabica beans.
news.content: The Trade Promotion Directorate announced that streamlined transport protocols on the Ethio-Djibouti rail line and direct cooperative sales contributed to a 22% year-on-year increase in coffee export receipts.
